name: rosetta-pairs-with-common-factors
code:
use default

let limit = 1_000_000
let totient = LIST(limit + 1)

(0::limit) |> each(value => totient.add(value))

for prime in 2::limit do
    if totient[prime] == prime then
        let multiple mut = prime

        while multiple <= limit do
            totient[multiple] = totient[multiple] / prime * (prime - 1)
            multiple = multiple + prime
        od
    fi
od

sharing_a_factor() -> Pipe[long] is
    let coprime_total mut = 0L

    for count in 1::limit do
        coprime_total = coprime_total + cast long(totient[count])

        yield cast long(count) * cast(count - 1) / 2L + 1L - coprime_total
    od
si

let terms = sharing_a_factor() |> collect()

write_line("the first 100 terms:")

terms
    |> take(100)
    |> chunk(10)
    |> each(row => write_line(row |> map(term => "{term,5}") |> join("")))

write_line()

[1_000, 10_000, 100_000, 1_000_000]
    |> each(count => write_line("a({count,9:N0}) = {terms[count - 1]:N0}"))
